summary: Iteration 2 (full frontend redesign to vintage film-poster). Backend unchanged and remains 100% (5/5 pytest). Frontend redesign fully tested end-to-end: Hero (headline 'Your Complete Content Creation Partner.', clapperboard slate card, BOOK A SHOOT CTA), Reel Wall (reel-0..5 render, clicking reel-0 mounts iframe/video), YouTube (featured-video + 9 channels), Comparison (5 rows), FAQ (faq-0..4 with expand/collapse verified via item data-state closed->open->closed), Testimonials hidden by default, Contact form empty-validation (error toast + no POST) + valid submit (success toast + form cleared + lead persisted via GET /api/leads), Admin toggle round trip (OFF->ON shows section, ON->OFF removes section, final state show_testimonials=false confirmed via API). Backend sanity endpoints (/api/, /api/settings) confirmed live.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: LeadCreate uses plain str for email (min_length=3). Backend still accepts malformed emails; consider EmailStr since pydantic[email] is available.
Contact.jsx: no client-side email format regex validation before POST; relies solely on required-field check.
Contact.jsx: dead code `const inputCls = 'hidden'; void inputCls;` — remove for cleanliness.

ReelWall.jsx / Home.jsx sections use `whileInView` motion which combined with Lenis smooth scroll makes hash-anchor navigation ineffective; navbar links that use href='#reels' etc. do not scroll (test-only observation — anchors are unused by the user primarily but nav still shows them).
seed_data_creation: A few TEST_ prefixed leads inserted via automated form submissions (harmless, only visible on admin-only GET /api/leads). settings.show_testimonials reset to false at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Radix Accordion state lives on the AccordionItem (data-testid='faq-{i}'), NOT the trigger button — assert `data-state` on the item. Sonner toasts render as `[data-sonner-toast]` with attribute data-type='success'|'error' — poll within 3s after submit. Contact form uses motion.form with whileInView, so scroll_into_view_if_needed before interacting and allow ~1s for framer-motion mount. Site uses Lenis smooth scroll — use scrollIntoView / window.scrollTo, not hash nav. settings.show_testimonials was left false; SiteSettings singleton _id='site' in db.settings.
